mostWorthwhile.text: Following dissolved volatiles from exsolution through volcanic plumes to a retained atmosphere clearly connected the stages of outgassing.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final crust-building sequence felt somewhat repetitive: each step was the only available combination, though the changing surface was clear.

surprise.text: The cracked crust provides routes for later water, connecting present volcanic activity to a future process.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the offered combinations had clear purposes, even when only one was available.

continue.text: I would continue to see how rain interacts with the contrasting hot lava and solid crust; the final passage set up that question well.
